source_contract.behavior: GET /access-denied renders a static 403 denial page with explanatory text and a Return home link.
source_contract.data_access: No tenant, user, resource, provider, WordPress, queue, persistence, or mutation access is required.
source_contract.security_implication: Laravel must preserve the anonymous and identity-neutral boundary rather than fabricate auth or tenant middleware.

tenant_neutral_security.anonymous: Anonymous caller receives the same static denial document as authenticated callers.
tenant_neutral_security.tenant_a_b_equivalence: Tenant A and Tenant B authenticated callers receive byte-identical static content.
tenant_neutral_security.identity_non_disclosure: Focused tests assert tenant names/slugs and user names/emails are absent from anonymous and authenticated responses.
tenant_neutral_security.idor_surface: None: route has zero parameters and controller resolves no tenant, user, or resource identity.
